messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer tenant `t-omega` reports ~12k audit events missing from yesterday's SIEM export. Their manifest shows expected 24 objects but only 18 delivered. They saw intermittent 403s during the 17:00-18:00 UTC window. Anyone seen this pattern recently?

ashok: Which forwarder was used (kinesis vs s3-forwarder)? region + manifest id?

maria: s3-forwarder in us-west-2. Manifest: s3://redwood-audit-prod/exports/tenant=t-omega/date=2026-03-14/manifest-20260314-1703.json

tracey: Quick glance — 403s + partial objects often point at KMS envelope decrypt failures when an alias rotation hits HSM-backed keys. Can you paste the forwarder logs around 17:23?

maria: Pasted snippet from forwarder logs below:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-14T17:22:59Z upload chunk 17/24 s3://.../chunk-17.gz
[ERROR] 2026-03-14T17:23:11Z PutObject failed: 403 AccessDenied (x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms) - KMS:Decrypt failed for key alias/redwood-hsm-prod (ResourceNotFoundException)
[WARN] 2026-03-14T17:23:12Z retrying upload (attempt 2)
[ERROR] 2026-03-14T17:23:43Z PutObject failed: 403 AccessDenied - KMS:Decrypt failed
```

ashok: That ResourceNotFoundException for alias is the smoking gun. Did we roll an HSM alias yesterday?

tracey: Ops notes show a scheduled HSM rotation at 17:10 but the rotation job migrated alias -> new-key-id and we saw delayed KMS policy cache invalidation in the forwarder instances. If the forwarder cache still references the old envelope key-id, S3 returns 403 when trying to reencrypt metadata.

maria: Customer says they retried a manual export and new exports look fine now but they need the missing 12k events backfilled. They also mentioned some delivered files had truncated sizes (gzip errors) when SIEM tried to unpack.

audit-bot: export-run/8921 failed -> exit_code=2, retry=scheduled at 2026-03-14T17:30:00Z, forwarder=us-west-2-s3-forwarder-7

jules: I can run a targeted replay/backfill for t-omega for that window. Need two things: the last successful event cursor before the gap (last_event_id) and the exact timebucket range. Can you share the manifest id and any object keys that succeeded vs failed?

maria: Manifest lists: delivered keys: [chunk-01.gz, chunk-02.gz, chunk-03.gz, chunk-05.gz, chunk-06.gz, chunk-09.gz, chunk-10.gz, chunk-11.gz, chunk-12.gz, chunk-14.gz, chunk-15.gz, chunk-18.gz, chunk-19.gz, chunk-20.gz, chunk-22.gz, chunk-24.gz] — missing 4/7/8/13/16/17/21/23. last_event_id before gap = evt_20260314_17_1153. Timebucket = 2026-03-14T17:00:00Z -> 2026-03-14T18:00:00Z

ashok: Thanks. Two actionable items: 1) tracey / infra to confirm KMS alias rotation path and make sure forwarder role can decrypt with new key-id; 2) jules to run backfill for the listed missing chunk ids and validate gzip checksums before handing to SIEM.

tracey: I'll check the KMS key policy and HSM rotation logs. If policy cache was slow, we should add a short pause after alias swap and a cache-bump event to the forwarder via SSM. Also will audit CloudTrail for any PutKeyPolicy calls around 17:05-17:20.

jules: I'll queue a backfill job now (backfill-job/5532). Will run checksum validation and upload to a quarantine prefix first: s3://redwood-audit-prod/backfill/t-omega/20260314-17/quarantine/. Will share presigned links for SIEM to pick up after validation. ETA initial artifacts 30-45m.

maria: Customer notified, they asked for an after-action note about alias rotations and recommended mitigation (stagger alias swap + cache-bump). I'll follow up with timeline once tracey confirms. :thumbsup:

tracey: Confirmed: alias swap executed at 17:10 UTC, KMS returned ResourceNotFound for 17:22 forwarder calls due to race on alias metadata propagation. Filing infra ticket to add hook to rotation: publish SSM param /kms/cache-bump/<region> that forwarders subscribe to.

jules: Backfill job completed and checksum-validated the 8 missing chunks. Uploaded to quarantine path and created manifest backfill-manifest-5532.json. Sharing logs and presigned urls in private thread.

maria: Closing loop with customer and marking incident remedied. Will add playbook step for future HSM rotations. Thanks everyone.
